name: Stelvio Pass
description: From Prato allo Stelvio up 48 numbered hairpins to 2,757 m, then down to Bormio: the most famous pass road in the Alps

name: Gavia Pass
description: Narrow, high and wild pass from Bormio to Ponte di Legno, 2,621 m, often with snow walls in early summer

name: Great Dolomite Road
description: Bolzano to Cortina d'Ampezzo over the Costalunga, Pordoi and Falzarego passes through the Dolomites

name: Sella Pass
description: Hairpins under the Sella and Sassolungo towers between Val Gardena and Val di Fassa, part of the Sella Ronda loop

name: Giau Pass
description: Steep Dolomites pass near Cortina with 29 hairpins and a famous view of the Cinque Torri

name: Grossglockner High Alpine Road
description: Toll road over the Hohe Tauern to the foot of Austria's highest mountain and the Pasterze glacier, with 36 hairpins

name: Timmelsjoch
description: High toll pass from the Ötztal in Austria to the Passeier Valley in South Tyrol, open in daytime only

name: Silvretta High Alpine Road
description: Toll road with 34 hairpins over the Bielerhöhe and the Silvretta reservoir between Vorarlberg and Tyrol

name: Nockalm Road
description: Gentle toll road with 52 bends through the rounded Nock Mountains of Carinthia

name: German Alpine Road
description: Along the Bavarian Alps from Lake Constance to Berchtesgaden, past Neuschwanstein and the Alpine lakes

name: Furka Pass
description: Gletsch to Realp at 2,429 m, past the Rhône Glacier and the hotel Belvédère from Goldfinger

name: Grimsel Pass
description: Innertkirchen to Gletsch past granite and dam lakes at 2,164 m, usually paired with the Furka

name: Susten Pass
description: Innertkirchen to Wassen with tunnels, glacier views and wide sweeping bends at 2,224 m

name: Gotthard Pass (Tremola)
description: Andermatt to Airolo; the old cobbled Tremola road twists down the Ticino side in 24 hairpins

name: Nufenen Pass
description: Switzerland's highest pass road inside the country (2,478 m), from Ulrichen in the Valais to Airolo

name: Great St Bernard Pass
description: Martigny to Aosta over the 2,469 m pass and its hospice, the old way from the Valais into Italy

name: Klausen Pass
description: Altdorf to Linthal past the Urnerboden alpine pasture, scene of the famous hill climb races

name: San Bernardino Pass
description: The old pass road over the Rheinwald to Mesocco, above the year-round tunnel

name: Bernina Pass
description: St. Moritz to Tirano past the Morteratsch glacier and Lago Bianco, beside the Bernina railway

name: Julier and Albula Passes
description: Into the Engadine from Tiefencastel over the Julier, coming back over the narrow Albula

name: Col du Galibier
description: Tour de France climb from Valloire over 2,642 m down to the Col du Lautaret

name: Col de l'Iseran
description: The highest paved pass in the Alps (2,764 m), from Bourg-Saint-Maurice through Val d'Isère to Lanslebourg

name: Route des Grandes Alpes
description: Lake Geneva to the Riviera over 16 passes including the Iseran, Galibier, Izoard and Bonette

name: Col de la Bonette
description: Jausiers to Saint-Étienne-de-Tinée with a summit loop to 2,802 m, the highest through road in Europe

name: Gorges du Verdon
description: Around Europe's grandest canyon on the Route des Crêtes and the D952 above the turquoise Verdon river
